purpose: Teach: 友の会/回分/新譜/吹き替え/データー/ゲージ/コンソール/特番

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、お客様の友の会の運営を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our customer loyalty program operations.
lines.style: Clipped, businesslike. Each phrase lands with equal weight. No inflection—this is instruction, not discussion. Posture: forward, decisive.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内研修を全部で十回分予定します
lines.en: Understood. I'm planning ten in-house training sessions.
lines.style: Steady confirmation. Slight pause after the affirmative, then factual delivery. Respectful but unadorned. The tone of someone noting what they've already begun.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、契約アーティストの新譜販促を強化しろ
lines.en: Strengthen our contracted artists' new release promotion.
lines.style: Same clipped cadence as before. No variation—this is a list being delivered through him. Eye contact neutral, professional. Pure instruction.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新CMの吹き替え収録を来週おこないます
lines.en: Understood. We'll be recording new commercial voiceovers next week.
lines.style: Same steady pace. Slightly more specific this time—a concrete date grounds the response. Demonstrates readiness, not hesitation.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、市場データー、つまり統計データの精度を高めろ
lines.en: Strengthen the accuracy of our market data—our statistical metrics.
lines.style: Slight emphasis on 'accuracy'—this matters more. The clarification on 'statistical' is precise, almost pedantic. Measured. Expects understanding.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。生産ラインのゲージ計測を再校正します
lines.en: Understood. We'll recalibrate the production line gauges.
lines.style: Steady, professional. A beat of competence here—he's moving from listening to acting. No excitement, no hesitation. Factual.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、店舗のコンソール画面の操作性を上げろ
lines.en: Strengthen the usability of our in-store console interface.
lines.style: Same delivery. Final instruction in the sequence. Slightly heavier landing on 'usability'—this is the last directive before closure. Still clipped, still certain.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新商品発表の特番を組みます
lines.en: Understood. We'll produce a special program for the new product launch.
lines.style: Final affirmation. Slightly fuller than the others—this is the closing response. Professional warmth barely registers, but presence settles. Ready to be dismissed.
